issues.name: Cost of Living
issues.summary: Household expenses such as energy bills, rents, transport fares, food prices and state taxes and charges.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Cost of living is not one portfolio. The Commonwealth sets income tax, most welfare payments and monetary policy; Victoria sets state taxes and charges, energy regulation within the National Electricity Market framework, public transport fares, stamp duty and many service fees.
issues.state_role: State taxes and charges, public transport fares, energy consumer protections, some concessions, and land tax / stamp duty settings.

issues.name: Energy
issues.summary: Electricity and gas supply, prices, generation mix, networks and consumer protections in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Energy is a shared field. Victoria participates in the National Electricity Market and can set state energy policy, consumer protections and some generation and storage decisions; the Commonwealth influences national market rules, emissions targets and major funding programs.
issues.state_role: State energy policy, licensing and consumer protection agencies, state-owned or contracted projects, and many household energy concession schemes.

issues.name: Education
issues.summary: Public schools, curriculum within state systems, TAFE and early childhood services run or regulated by Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Schooling is primarily a state responsibility in Australia. The Commonwealth provides major funding to schools and runs national curriculum and higher education frameworks; day-to-day public school systems and TAFE are state-led.
issues.state_role: Public schools, state curriculum implementation, teacher employment in the state system, TAFE and many early childhood programs.

issues.name: Immigration
issues.summary: Who may enter and stay in Australia, permanent migration settings and citizenship — largely Commonwealth powers.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Immigration, visas and citizenship are Commonwealth powers under the Australian Constitution. Victorian governments can advocate, run settlement services, and set some skilled-migration nomination programs, but they do not control national migration levels or border policy.
issues.state_role: Settlement services, multicultural programs, and limited state-nominated skilled migration pathways within federal caps.

issues.name: Crime & Justice
issues.summary: Policing, courts, corrections, youth justice and criminal law in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Criminal law, police and prisons for ordinary offences are primarily state responsibilities. The Commonwealth runs federal courts and agencies for federal offences, including some national-security and drug-trafficking matters.
issues.state_role: Victoria Police, state courts, Corrections Victoria, youth justice, and most criminal offences and sentencing laws.

issues.name: Firearms Policy
issues.summary: Firearm licensing, ownership rules, categories, storage, enforcement, trafficking and lawful sporting, hunting and farming use in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Victoria administers firearm licensing, registration, categories, storage requirements, prohibition orders and most firearm offences under state law. National agreements, imports, border controls and the emerging national firearms register involve the Commonwealth and other jurisdictions.
issues.state_role: The Firearms Act, licences and permits, registration and storage rules, firearm prohibition orders, trafficking offences and Victoria Police enforcement.

issues.name: Corruption
issues.summary: Integrity bodies, political donation rules, lobbying transparency and public-sector integrity in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Victoria’s Independent Broad-based Anti-corruption Commission, electoral donation rules for state elections, and most public-sector integrity settings are state law. Commonwealth integrity bodies cover federal public officials and federal elections.
issues.state_role: IBAC and related Victorian integrity agencies, state electoral funding and disclosure rules, and public-sector codes.

issues.name: Debt & Budget
issues.summary: Victorian state budget balance, net debt, taxes and major expenditure priorities of the State of Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: The Victorian Treasurer and Parliament control the state budget, state taxes and state borrowings. Commonwealth grants are a large revenue source, but state debt and state spending priorities are state decisions.
issues.state_role: State budget, state taxes, state borrowings and interest, and major recurrent and capital programs.

issues.name: Environment & Forestry
issues.summary: Land use, forests, native vegetation, pollution regulation and environmental approvals in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Day-to-day environmental regulation and public-land management are largely state responsibilities. The Commonwealth Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act can apply to matters of national environmental significance.
issues.state_role: State environment-protection laws, public-land and forest management, and many planning-linked environmental controls.

issues.name: Gender Equality & Social Policy
issues.summary: Anti-discrimination law, family-violence responses, LGBTQIA+ policy and related social legislation in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Both levels of government pass anti-discrimination and social-policy laws. Victoria has extensive state legislation and service systems; the Commonwealth runs national schemes including much of family law and income support.
issues.state_role: Victorian equal-opportunity and anti-discrimination frameworks, family-violence service systems, and many state social programs.

issues.name: Climate & Biodiversity
issues.summary: Emissions-reduction targets, climate adaptation, threatened species and biodiversity programs affecting Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Climate and biodiversity cut across federal and state law. Victoria can set state targets, adaptation plans and nature programs; national targets, international commitments and EPBC-related decisions sit with the Commonwealth.
issues.state_role: State emissions targets and policies, climate-adaptation programs, and state biodiversity and threatened-species tools.

issues.name: Aboriginal Affairs & Reconciliation
issues.summary: Treaty, truth-telling, self-determination policy and Aboriginal services in the Victorian jurisdiction.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Victoria has pursued state treaty and truth-telling processes under state law. Native title, some heritage frameworks and many national Closing the Gap settings involve the Commonwealth. Practical service delivery is often shared.
issues.state_role: Victorian treaty and truth-telling institutions, state Aboriginal-affairs policy, and many funded services.

issues.name: Housing & Planning
issues.summary: Housing supply, social housing, renting rules and land-use planning across Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Planning schemes and social housing are primarily state-led, with councils administering much day-to-day planning. The Commonwealth influences housing through tax settings, migration, funding deals and national housing programs, but building permits and zoning are not federal day-to-day work.
issues.state_role: Planning legislation, housing targets, social and affordable housing programs, and residential-tenancies law.

issues.name: Health & Hospitals
issues.summary: Public hospitals, ambulance services and state-run health systems in Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Public hospitals and ambulance services are primarily state-run. Medicare, the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme and much primary-care funding are Commonwealth responsibilities. Aged care is largely federal with some state interfaces.
issues.state_role: Public hospital networks, ambulance services, and many public-health programs.

issues.name: Infrastructure & Transport
issues.summary: Roads, public transport, major projects and freight networks within Victoria.
issues.jurisdiction_note: Most urban public transport and state roads are Victorian responsibilities. The Commonwealth funds and influences major projects and national highways and regulates aspects of aviation and interstate transport.
issues.state_role: Metro and regional public transport, state arterial roads, and major state capital projects.
